verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine documents its own import and export of content in glTF, an open Khronos standard, so some project data can leave in an open format. USD is only documented for importing and editing (and is Beta), and FBX is an Autodesk-owned format documented for import. Nothing shows a complete export of a project, such as Blueprints, levels and .uasset content, in open formats. missing for 10: evidence of whole-project export beyond glTF scenes and meshes, a documented open-format export path for Blueprints, maps and other engine-native assets, a stable (non-Beta) USD export, and independent hands-on corroboration of migrating off the engine.
